mapped_topics.label: Rank of a matrix by Echelon form
Rank of a matrix by Normal form

blocks.text: Rank gives the number of independent rows.
A normal form contains an identity block.
Both row and column transformations may be used to reduce a matrix to normal form.
For echelon form, use row transformations only.
Matrices of the form \([I_r\ 0]\), \(\begin{bmatrix}I_r\\0\end{bmatrix}\), and \(\begin{bmatrix}I_r&0\\0&0\end{bmatrix}\) are in normal form, where \(I_r\) is an identity matrix.
After reducing a matrix to normal form, \(\rho(A)\) is the order of the identity block.
